integrity: New centered-variance phase classification derived from openly acknowledged published moment identities. Formal proof and reproducibility code supplied. No independently performed mathematical or priority audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for a two-dimensional active Brownian particle with strictly positive isotropic linear confinement and propulsion, unit rotational diffusion, isotropic translational diffusivity, and simultaneous Poisson resetting of position and angle to a deterministic origin/alignment. Existing work supplies exact underlying moments; novelty resides in a global centered-covariance eigenvalue ordering and the exact two-crossing phase-boundary asymptotics. General prior results could implicitly imply the classification.
title: Reentrant centered-variance anisotropy under complete resetting of a trapped active Brownian particle
